name: Undergraduate / IP Internship Offer
body:
{{offer_date}}

{{applicant_name}}

Dear {{applicant_name}},

RE: OFFER OF INTERNSHIP — {{programme_name}}

We are pleased to extend an offer of internship to you at the Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA). This letter sets out the terms and conditions of your internship, and forms a binding agreement upon your acceptance.

1.  INTERNSHIP DETAILS

    Programme          :  {{programme_name}}
    Project Title      :  {{project_title}}
    Mentor             :  {{mentor_name}}
    Duration           :  {{internship_duration}}
    Working Location   :  {{working_location}}

2.  REMUNERATION

    Monthly Stipend    :  {{monthly_stipend}}
    Payment Schedule   :  Monthly, credited by the 25th of each month
    Payment Method     :  Direct bank transfer to the account provided in Section 5

    The above stipend is a fixed monthly allowance inclusive of all benefits. CPF contributions are not applicable for internship arrangements. No overtime, leave encashment, or other supplementary payments will be made unless expressly stated.

3.  VENUE AND REPORTING DETAILS

    Reporting Venue    :  {{reporting_venue}}
    Reporting Date     :  {{internship_start_date}}
    Reporting Time     :  {{reporting_time}}
    Reporting Contact  :  {{reporting_contact}}

    Please arrive punctually on your first day and proceed to the security counter to register as a visitor. Your mentor will meet you and arrange your intern access pass thereafter. Failure to report on the stipulated date without prior notice may result in forfeiture of this offer.

    Please bring the following on your first day:

    (i)   This signed offer letter (all pages);
    (ii)  A photocopy of your NRIC / FIN / passport;
    (iii) Your most recent academic transcript or letter of enrolment;
    (iv)  Completed Bank Account Particulars (Section 5 of this letter).

4.  TERMS AND CONDITIONS

    a.  This offer is conditional upon satisfactory verification of your academic eligibility and enrolment status. DSTA reserves the right to withdraw this offer if verification is unsatisfactory.

    b.  The internship may be terminated by either party with one (1) week's written notice. DSTA may terminate the internship immediately and without notice in the event of misconduct, breach of confidentiality, security violations, or failure to maintain satisfactory performance.

    c.  You are required to maintain strict confidentiality of all DSTA information — including classified, restricted, and official sensitive material — encountered during the internship. This obligation survives the termination or expiry of the internship.

    d.  Any work, invention, discovery, or intellectual property created, developed, or contributed to in the course of the internship shall vest solely and exclusively in DSTA.

    e.  You are required to notify your mentor and internship@dsta.gov.sg at least one (1) working day in advance of any absence. Absence exceeding three (3) consecutive working days without notification may result in immediate termination of the internship and pro-rata clawback of stipend paid for the relevant period.

    f.  You shall comply with DSTA's IT and cybersecurity policies at all times, including but not limited to restrictions on the transfer of official data to personal storage media, prohibition on connecting personal devices to DSTA internal networks, and adherence to data classification handling procedures.

    g.  You are not permitted to engage in any external employment, freelance work, or other paid activity that conflicts with your internship duties or DSTA's interests during the internship period without prior written approval.

    h.  Upon satisfactory completion, DSTA may, at its discretion, consider the intern for scholarship sponsorship or direct employment. This clause does not constitute a commitment or guarantee of any subsequent offer.

5.  BANK ACCOUNT PARTICULARS (FOR STIPEND CREDITING)

    Please complete this section in full and return the signed letter to internship@dsta.gov.sg within 5 working days of accepting this offer. Stipend payment will only be processed upon receipt of complete bank details.

    Full Name (as per bank records)  :  ____________________________________________
    Bank Name                        :  ____________________________________________
    Bank Account Number              :  ____________________________________________
    Bank Branch Code / SWIFT Code    :  ____________________________________________
    PayNow-Registered NRIC (if any)  :  ____________________________________________

    I confirm that the above account belongs to me and I authorise DSTA to credit my internship stipend to the stated account.

    Signature  :  ____________________________________________
    Date       :  ____________________________________________

6.  MOBILE DEVICE AND PERSONAL ELECTRONIC DEVICE DECLARATION

    DSTA is a restricted government facility. In connection with your internship, you are required to read, acknowledge, and sign the following declaration before commencing:

    a.  I understand that DSTA premises are restricted areas and that all persons and their belongings, including personal electronic devices, are subject to security screening upon entry.

    b.  I undertake not to photograph, film, audio-record, or transmit any image, sound, document, or information from within DSTA premises or from any DSTA system, without prior written authorisation from my supervising officer or the DSTA Security Office.

    c.  I understand that I may be required to surrender, store, or power off mobile devices and other recording equipment at designated security points, and I agree to comply with any such instruction.

    d.  I agree to comply with DSTA's Mobile Device Management (MDM) policy if I am issued with or given access to a DSTA-managed device, including consent to remote wipe of official data in the event of loss or breach.

    e.  DSTA reserves the right to inspect any personal electronic device brought onto its premises where there are reasonable security grounds to do so, and I consent to such inspection.

    I, the undersigned, declare that I have read and fully understood the above and agree to be bound by these conditions for the entire duration of my internship at DSTA.

    Full Name  :  ____________________________________________
    NRIC / FIN :  ____________________________________________
    Signature  :  ____________________________________________
    Date       :  ____________________________________________

7.  ACCEPTANCE

    Please indicate your acceptance or declination of this offer within 7 working days via the DSTA Talent Portal:
    {{portal_link}}

    By accepting this offer, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to all terms and conditions set out in this letter, including the declarations in Sections 5 and 6.

    Failure to respond within the stipulated period will be deemed as a declination of this offer, and DSTA reserves the right to extend the offer to another candidate.

Should you have any questions regarding this offer, please do not hesitate to contact us at internship@dsta.gov.sg.

We look forward to welcoming you to DSTA.

Yours sincerely,


Davina Lim
Internship Officer
Talent Outreach & Acquisition
Defence Science and Technology Agency
Singapore 638510
Tel: 6796 8888 | internship@dsta.gov.sg

    g.  You shall comply with DSTA's IT and cybersecurity policies at all times, including but not limited to restrictions on the transfer of official data to personal storage media, prohibition on connecting personal devices to DSTA internal networks, and adherence to data classification handling procedures.
